indicator_name: Healthy life expectancy based on self-perceived health

graph_titles.title: Healthy life expectancy based on self-perceived health

national_indicator_definition: This indicator estimates the number of years a person is expected to live in good self-perceived health. It is based on mortality data combined with data on self-perceived health from the EU Statistics on Income and Living Conditions (EU-SILC).
national_rationale: This indicator is part of the EU Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) indicator set. It is used to monitor progress towards SDG 3 – Good Health and Well-being and SDG 1 – No Poverty, as a multi-purpose indicator (MPI). These goals are linked to the European Commission’s 2024–2029 priorities, particularly “Supporting people, strengthening our societies and our social model”.
national_methodology_characteristics: Good health is important for quality of life, well-being and social participation, and is also an important prerequisite for economic development. Monitoring SDG 3 in the EU context covers healthy lives, health determinants, causes of death and healthcare.
national_long_objective: No specific quantitative long-term target has been established for this indicator.
